options.name: account_id
options.description: The ID of the account that contains the resource groups that you want to get.

options.name: date
options.description: The date in the format of YYYY-MM which returns resource groups. Deleted resource groups will be excluded before this month.

options.name: default
options.description: Boolean value to specify whether or not to list default resource groups.

options.name: include_deleted
options.description: Boolean value to specify whether or not to list default resource groups.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the resource group.
